risk_note: RV2 (console app-version management, gates the 10405 force-update; no funds). Three /admin/v1/app-versions* operations on content.app_version (reads without step-up). Save pre-reads the current row before the guard and asks for the totp step-up only when the minimum supported version is raised (including from none); business rejections are thrown inside the guard so the token is not consumed. Order: format 20001, then the row is locked FOR UPDATE, expected_row_version CAS (20902 resource=app_version), the locked row is re-compared with the pre-read (20902 if it changed), BR-ID-01 pre-save store check against the locked row (20001), then the row and the audit row app_version_save in one transaction. Concurrent creates hitting the unique key map to 20902. Store keys come from a generated content/specs/app-stores.gen.ts (existing snapshots byte-identical). Orchestrator approved defaults Y0-Y6. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
